entities.summary: Mark Anthony Jackson is an American former professional football player who was a wide receiver in the National Football League (NFL). He selected by the Denver Broncos in the sixth round of the 1986 NFL draft. Jackson attended high school at Terre Haute South Vigo High School and Alton Senior High School.
